# costfluent_cost_report_subscription (Resource)

Manages a report notification: a saved cost report delivered on a schedule to email, Slack or Teams apps. Needs a token with `manageCostReportSubscriptions` and `viewCostReportSubscriptions` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costfluent_workspace" "production" {
  name     = "Production"
  currency = "USD"
}

resource "costfluent_cost_report" "monthly" {
  workspace_id  = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  title         = "Monthly spend"
  date_interval = "last30Days"
}

resource "costfluent_app" "finance" {
  key    = "email"
  name   = "Finance"
  config = jsonencode({ recipients = "finance@example.com" })
}

# Weekly, at 8 o'clock Berlin time
resource "costfluent_cost_report_subscription" "weekly" {
  workspace_id   = costfluent_workspace.production.id
  cost_report_id = costfluent_cost_report.monthly.id
  name           = "Weekly spend"
  schedule_type  = "weekly"
  delivery_hour  = 8
  time_zone      = "Europe/Berlin"
  app_ids        = [costfluent_app.finance.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_ids` (List of String) The email, Slack or Teams apps each delivery goes to, at least one.
- `cost_report_id` (String) The saved cost report delivered. Changing it recreates the notification.
- `name` (String) Notification name.
- `schedule_type` (String) One of daily, weekly or monthly.

### Optional

- `delivery_hour` (Number) The hour, 0 to 23 on the wall clock of time_zone, each delivery lands on. The API's 9 when omitted.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the notification delivers; false pauses it without deleting it.
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone the schedule runs in, such as Europe/Berlin. The workspace's zone when omitted.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. When omitted, the provider's default workspace at creation is recorded and kept, so a later change to the provider's default does not move it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Report notification ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The configuration sets workspace_id: "<workspace ID>:<report notification ID>". Import with that
# workspace, because changing a configured workspace_id recreates the report notification.
terraform import costfluent_cost_report_subscription.weekly wsp_0000000000000000000001:crs_0000000000000000000001

# The configuration leaves workspace_id out: the bare ID imports from the provider's workspace,
# which state then keeps.
terraform import costfluent_cost_report_subscription.weekly crs_0000000000000000000001
```
